item.description:
DragStore 2.1.0

DragStore now works much more like the Finder and is ready for macOS 27.

New

  • Finder-style browsing: a click selects files and folders, a double-click opens them. Hold a file over a folder to open it, and drag to the edge of the list to scroll.
  • Cancel uploads at any time.
  • New + menu to create folders, upload files and add files from Google Drive.
  • Shortcuts and Spotlight actions: open DragStore, upload files, auto-sort files*.
  • Redesigned Smart Folders settings*, now right inside Settings.

Bug fixes and improvements

  • Uploads and auto sort no longer fail silently, for example right after launch or when signed out. You now get a short message instead.
  • Smart folders stay in place when you rename or move them, and deleted folders are no longer used*.
  • More reliable "Add from Google Drive".
  • Smoother animations and clearer error messages.
  • Temporary files are cleaned up automatically.

* requires macOS 26 or later and a Mac with an Apple Chip
